summary: Table S4b and Figure S4C report P35 versus P12 in arcuate NeuN-positive RNA libraries across both sexes. HypoExplorer estimates the age difference within female pools. The authors’ code defines the female contrast, but the public tables, labelled figures and code archive supply no gene-level estimate for it.

manualReview.summary: Published neuronal age effects pool both sexes. The archived female coefficient has no deposited result table.
manualReview.note: For track arc_neun, the registered female_neun_pnd35_vs_pnd12 contrast uses five independent four-mouse female pools at P12 and five at P35. All ten libraries match Table S1 and GEO. The registered limma coefficient measures P35 minus P12 on deposited VSD values. S4b reports shrunken DESeq2 log2 fold changes across sexes, including five male P12 and four male P35 pools. Its 863 paper-threshold calls reproduce the two counts in Figure S4C. The sex sheets compare male with female at fixed ages. Figure S4E shows per-pool TPM against methylation, and the female-age entries in S2/S3 are methylation results. Zenodo defines group_neuron35f_vs_neuron12f but omits the numerical output. The GEO RNA supplement contains VSD expression, and the sample files contain methylation coverage. Female-age effects, P values and FDR remain unassessed. See continued-sources/GSE189945/codex-2026-11-24/SEARCH_LOG.md and audit.json.

verificationReview.reason: S4b and Figure S4C estimate P35 versus P12 across male and female neuronal libraries using a shrunken DESeq2 count-model coefficient. The registered contrast estimates P35 minus P12 among female neuronal pools using limma on VSD expression. The archived script defines the female-only coefficient, but no gene-level output for it was located in the public record.
